## Course Background

- **FRSC 5003H** is a graduate course in the MScFS program, that:
    - covers topics of importance to conducting effective research
    - allows students to **practice** applying skills in preparation for life outside of school<br><br>
    
- Primary areas of emphasis are research design, critical thinking, and basic data analysis

- Secondary area of emphasis is advanced data analysis; reading and writing source code in the **R programming language**

::: {.notes}

:::

## Course Structure

- **Most Lectures**:
    - 45-50 minutes for presentation about lecture topic; rest of the time to discuss lecture topics and other topics of interest, work on assignments/activities <br><br>
    
- **Most Seminars**:
    - **OPEN WORK SESSIONS**: Time to work on research activities, study for test, read optional papers, prepare for your placement, etc. <br><br>
    
- **All lectures will be live streamed and recorded.**
